## RunDestinationResourceClient.list() method

List run destinations, as one page holding all of them. When several workspace documents share the same name, the first match in the app's order is used as the workspace document.

**Signature:**

```typescript
list(workspaceName: string, options?: CallOptions): Promise<Page<RunDestination>>;
```
